responsibility: Declares the SSA liveness and partition-mapping infrastructure used by out-of-SSA, TER, and coalescing. It defines var_map and tree_live_info data structures, inline accessors for partition/view/base-variable queries and live-in/live-out bitmaps, and the APIs to build, inspect, and destroy liveness data for whole functions or loop regions.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the public liveness and partition-management data structures and inline/query APIs, such as var_map, tree_live_info, partition accessors, and live-in/live-out access helpers. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-live.cc, it does not implement liveness computation, partition compaction, or verification routines.
